blockers.name: Native parity
blockers.evidence: LangGraphParityRuntimeV2 exposes plan_run, pause_run, resume_run, cancel_run as state-only stubs. plan_run only marks planner_used and graph_internal_planner; it does not call build_plan or produce a native-equivalent plan. pause/resume/cancel only mutate status string. NativeAgentRuntimeV2 implements full plan_run with planner/build_plan and semantic tool binding.
blockers.required_closure: Implement real planner binding and pause/resume/cancel semantics in LangGraphParityRuntimeV2 with parity tests against NativeAgentRuntimeV2.

partials.name: Observability
partials.evidence: API chat response exposes backend_selected, backend_fallback_used, backend_fallback_reason. Dashboard status route exposes agent_v2.backend but not backend_fallback_reason or backend_fallback_used.
partials.required_closure: Extend dashboard _agent_v2_snapshot to include backend_fallback_used and backend_fallback_reason.

partials.name: Operational cost and model routing
partials.evidence: PRIMARY_KIMI_MODEL is defined and provider_metadata exposes model_used and provider_used. No explicit per-step cost cap, model-routing policy, or budget enforcement is documented as runtime policy.
partials.required_closure: Document and enforce cost/step/model-routing policy in runtime configuration and governance.

basis: GATE-01 is still open. LangGraph canary works in isolated shell but cannot become global default until GATE-01 is closed. GATE-04 and GATE-08 remain partial but non-blocking for local canary.
